measurement: Same current audit and growth helper on exact historical shared sources. Reclaim at tick boundaries, 60s lost-cell memory reset on respawn. Net excludes initial/spawn grants and adds pre-neutralization death reset losses; not final held territory.
interpretation: Chronological nested additions. Adjacent contrasts conditional on earlier changes, not factorial independent effects. cbcc9c7 is an extra behavioral reachability correction separated from e4e2f08. Observer-only changes between listed commits do not define extra behavior arms.

cost.method: Same PC, each source warmup seed19/3600 excluded; 3 rounds x 8 paired seeds x all arms; cyclic arm rotations with reversed alternating six-block cycles (every arm occupies each timing position equally across 24 blocks); no observers; external test overlap recorded before/after each sample. Aggregate median of round means; seed median of three. Overlap or replicate instability reported, no invalid certification.

resourceGuard.probe: Record external Vitest/Playwright presence before/after every timing; retain all fixed rows, mark overlap, withhold cost certification
